diagnostics.title: TrueCost — what a loan actually costs
diagnostics.visibleText: ₹ TrueCost ◐ Know what your loan really costs. Effective APR, not the headline rate. Every fee, GST rupee and bundled premium counted. Compare loan offers Rank two or three lenders honestly Watch your rate Catch a reset your bank skipped Prepay or invest Post-tax, on both sides Continue with email Try it as a guest Guests get the loan comparison. Saving a loan needs an account, so it is still there next time.
